He is using a white manual slicer to cut a large white onion on a wooden cutting board, maintaining a focused and slightly comical expression. (2) Close-up shots of hands submersing a red onion into a glass bowl of water, followed by the man presenting a beautifully carved red onion that resembles a blooming flower. He carefully arranges these onion 'flowers' into a light blue decorative bouquet wrap adorned with warm fairy lights. (3) The scene shifts to a living room where a young woman in a black tank top and pink shorts sits on a grey couch. The man enters the frame and presents the glowing onion bouquet to her; she reacts with a shocked expression, covering her mouth with her hand. (4) The couple remains on the couch interacting; the woman takes the bouquet, laughs, and lean in to smell the onions. The man gestures excitedly while explaining his creation. (5) The final scene shows a plate of scrambled eggs mixed with purple onions on a black dining table, followed by a shot of the man eating the dish from a white bowl in the kitchen.
